registration.purpose: Paper-method reconstruction and matched-calibration-count improvement benchmark
registration.freshness: Both test strips were chosen geographically before retrieving their lidar or inspecting prediction errors; neither overlaps any earlier Key West reporting region. A 500m gap separates them from the previously inspected development area.
registration.datum: MLLW; do not add acquisition-time tide to a chart-datum SDB evaluation

nine_point_fallback.source: development lidar only; not the authors' chart soundings
nine_point_fallback.optical_eligibility: finite blue/red and blue/green ratios in both corrections and both filter variants; selection otherwise uses geometry and reference depth only
nine_point_fallback.selection: For each ascending target choose closest depth in an unused block; seeded random ordering breaks ties. Never select by retrieval error.

registration.dense_calibration: At most 10000 seeded observations sampled uniformly from eligible development pixels, shared across corrections, without evaluation data; uniform and equal-total-weight-per-depth-bin linear fits are compared.
registration.model_selection: No selection using fresh test errors. Report every registered variant. This is a prespecified comparison, not selection of a production winner.
registration.evaluation: Unblended predictions on all reference 0-5m pixels; finite prediction coverage, common support, depth strata, region, bias, MAE, median AE, RMSE, and paired 500m spatial-block bootstrap differences. Predictions outside 0-5m remain errors, never clipped or removed.

additional_interpretation_limits: Nine points were depth-selected using the full development DEM; nine fitted observations do not mean nine measurements supplied in total.
Lidar observations do not reproduce chart rounding, sounding positions, survey lineage or selection uncertainty.
Overall scores remain dominated by shallow pixels; compare every depth stratum and region.
All prespecified candidates are reported. Their relative ranking is now development evidence for any subsequent model selection.
